name: Allen Bolourchi
positions: AI Research, Product and Program Management at Meta Superintelligence Labs, FAIR
Adjunct Professor of Generative AI and NLP
summary: Allen Bolourchi leads AI research and product at Meta Superintelligence Labs and FAIR, and designed TAC 459 from the ground up as the capstone of the USC AI Minor. Previously, he led AI/ML personalization for the App Store and Apple Arcade at Apple.
